intent.architecture_claim: The Universum als Round Trip is claimed as an executable world formula under the repository's declared architectural definition.
intent.formalization: Inventory the repository- and Zenodo-backed claims, definitions, scopes, assumptions, relations, reference mappings and evidence boundaries; encode the formally meaningful subset in Lean; construct kernel-checkable proofs or explicit counterexamples and gaps.
intent.publication: Prepare verified repository-native release bundles for new Lean sources, theorem inventories, kernel receipts and bounded claim matrices, and prepare Zenodo and IETF candidates when materially required.
intent.interaction_policy: Continue autonomously through deterministic repository-internal work and fail closed at unresolved semantic, evidentiary, credential, legal, identity, external-service or irreversible-effect boundaries.

mandatory_status_separation.formal_status: Only explicitly inventoried, dependency-closed, kernel-accepted theorems are formally established.
mandatory_status_separation.physical_status: Only operationalized, reference-bound and evidence-supported propositions are physically qualified.
mandatory_status_separation.scientific_establishment: Requires recovery of known limits, distinctive predictions, empirical survival and independent validation.

formal_core_target.semantic_boundary: A |- T does not imply physical truth. Physical qualification requires an explicit interpretation/reference map iota and evidence concerning the induced empirical structure.
formal_core_target.superdeterminism_boundary: A_QIK |- not Superdeterministic(M_QIK) is a theorem about the formalized model and definition only; a claim about the universe additionally requires adequate definition, model-class coverage, reference binding and empirical coverage.

hard_fail_closed_gates: No theorem may be described as kernel-proved without an exact Lean toolchain, source commit, source tree, build command and successful kernel receipt.
No physical correspondence may be inferred solely from formal derivability.
No complete-world-formula, scientific-establishment, consensus, measurement or independent-validation status may be claimed without matching evidence.
No Zenodo or IETF mutation may occur when credentials, owner identity, target record, metadata, rights, exact artifact bytes or post-effect verification are unavailable.
No external publication may silently overwrite or version an unintended record.
No force push, history rewrite or destructive repository mutation is authorized.
No admitted, sorry, axiom-smuggled or unchecked proof gap may be represented as a completed proof.
A failure, ambiguity or missing source produces BLOCK or CONTINUE with the first exact blocker, never an invented completion claim.

completion_predicate.repository_formalization_complete: Every in-scope claim has a stable identifier, source/provenance, exact formal statement, assumptions, dependency closure, Lean status and kernel receipt or explicit non-proof disposition.
completion_predicate.physical_binding_complete: Every physically asserted claim has an explicit reference map, operationalization, known-limit evidence and uncertainty record.
completion_predicate.publication_complete: Repository, Zenodo and applicable IETF artifacts are byte-bound to post-effect receipts and reobserved at their persistent identifiers.
completion_predicate.global_completion: NOT_PREAUTHORIZED_AS_A_CLAIM; it may be emitted only when all declared predicates are evidenced.

owner_statement_digest: Product Owner authorization received to autonomously implement the necessary formal relations, construct and run Lean proofs from repository and Zenodo sources, prepare and where gated credentials permit publish verified outputs to Zenodo and applicable IETF channels, while requiring no routine interaction and preserving formal, physical and scientific claim boundaries.
